## What changes and why?

Describe the user problem, final behavior and linked issue if applicable.

## How was it verified?

List checks actually run and any untested host/device/network behavior. For UI or
animation, include a safe screenshot or short capture using fictional test people.
For consent/pairing changes, explain the enforced boundary and failure tests.

## Privacy and scope

Mention any change to permissions, retained data, network access or dependencies.
Never include real contacts, private conversations, invitation/session tokens,
connector files or credentials. Maintainers review, test and verify before merge.
